events.title: The demo is live, Next Fest is Oct 19-26, and here is what is next
events.summary: The free demo is out (build 25740568).What works: a thousand enemies at once, the 3D radar that shows the real ships, all seven weapons.What does not yet: the boss cannot move, react or die, and graphics cards without ray tracing can crash on the current build.The next update makes TSR the default upscaler and adds a low-end preset. After that comes the boss fight.Requirements: RTX 2060 / RX 6600 or better, 16 GB RAM, about 28 GB of disk.Jet Scalawag is in Steam Next Fest from Oct 19 to 26. Wish
